sources.title: AI in Experiments: Present Status and Future Prospects - MDPI
sources.snippet: Artificial intelligence (AI) has become deeply intertwined with scientific inquiry and experimentation. This Special Issue, "AI in Experiments: Present Status and Future Prospects", provides a timely snapshot of AI's evolving role across diverse experimental domains.
